title: <adapter>.result.json
description: What an action adapter actually did. Written atomically after a run so the shell can report the truth instead of assuming success — the theme fan-out reaches nine surfaces and any of them can be absent on a given machine.

ok.description: False when anything landed in `failed`. A pending surface is not a failure.

ts.description: Unix seconds. Lets a reader show the age rather than hide staleness.

pending.description: Surfaces that will change, but not yet. Each carries the reason, because 'restart Zen' is only actionable if it says why.

failed.description: Surfaces that could not be reached. A failure here never aborts the others.

tier.description: next-login is deliberately absent: the cursor was the last thing in it and hyprctl setcursor applies live.
